text:
mira: quick sync request: p95 on dashboard renders creeping up. root cause shows repeated full-policy checks across N widgets. thinking about adding a small 'auth projection' cache at the gateway to return a compact, versioned filter that downstreams can apply.

ben: high-level yes. two immediate q's: 1) how do we guarantee safety (no broadened perms)? 2) where to attach — header from gateway or gateway enriches requests?

mira: safety: projections must be conservative (never grant more). we'll run in audit mode initially. attach via gateway metadata so downstreams see same projection for entire fanout.

hao: sketch of payload: {etag, cols: ["c1","c2"], where: "tenant_id = ? AND status != ?", params: [42, "archived"]}. downstreams treat as advisory unless projection.mode=="strict".

sylvia: rollout plan proposal: 1) implement projection service + batch API behind flag; 2) gateway uses it in audit mode with 5% double-check sampling; 3) if divergence <0.2% over 7 days, enable for single-tenant dashboards; 4) expand. always include kill-switch.

ben: instrumentation: projection.latency_ms hist, projection.cache_hit_ratio, projection.divergence.count, downstream.render_saved_ms. also log etag mismatches for debugging.

hao: on invalidation: write paths (role change, seat revoke, resource update) must bump etag. provide fast invalidation hook and a short TTL (e.g., 30s) for sessions. consider soft-evict on high-change tenants.

sylvia: perf targets: median <6ms, p95 <25ms for projection RPC. batch API should accept up to 200 checks. gate through tenant-level rate limits to avoid noisy neighbors.

mira: failure modes: stale projection -> potential false-deny (safe) or under-restrict (unsafe). audit sampling will surface unsafe diffs. if any unsafe diffs observed, abort rollout.

ben: testing: unit for predicate correctness, integration with SQL services using paramized predicate, and end-to-end synthetic dash load. also chaos test: simulate role change during heavy read.

rafa: ops playbook: alert on projection.divergence.rate > 0.1% sustained 1h, projection.latency.p95 > 50ms. rollback steps: disable gateway enrich flag, purge projection cache, scale down projection fleet.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary queued for branch "proj-cache-proto" to staging. ETA ~20m.

mira: owners: mira (arch + RFC), hao (policy projection impl), ben (gateway + integration), sylvia (ops + SLOs), rafa (telemetry). i'll draft short RFC with API, metrics, rollout and share by EOD.

ben: ok, let's keep scope single-tenant dashboards first. less blast radius.

sylvia: +1. thanks all.
